scope.behavior: clean promoter classifier enrichment: margin(true GENCODE MANE TSS)-margin(composition-matched same-locus pseudo-TSS)
scope.candidate_set_source: replicated promoter clean-behavior head atlas v1
scope.licensed_if_qualified: strict CLS-write faithfulness, layer-11 pair specificity, target-dependent query involvement, and an early-candidate-to-layer-11 rescue path for the supervised promoter contrast
explicitly_excluded: a resolved promoter motif or nucleotide grammar

frozen_basis.threshold_basis: The candidate set and late pair were fixed from the sealed head atlas. Effect SESOIs are conservative fractions of the replicated 0.73-1.14 logit candidate-set patch effects. No unused target-locus circuit outcome was read.

cohort.source: remaining GENCODE v50 protein-coding MANE Select TSS cohort from promoter-classifier-v2

node_universe.heads: 144 pre-output-projection attention context slices at the unpadded CLS row
node_universe.mlps: 12 MLP wo residual writes at the unpadded CLS row
node_universe.pooler_and_classifier: fixed readout, outside the scrub universe
node_universe.initial_CLS_embedding: identical between each target/control pair and outside the scrub universe

faithfulness.definition: ratio of mean retained enrichment to mean native enrichment after every complement CLS head and MLP write is patched target<-paired control
faithfulness.bootstrap: locus-block resampling of the ratio of means
faithfulness.interpretation: estimated continuously; no post-hoc binary faithfulness cutoff

pair_specificity.null_family: all 45 candidate-excluding two-head pairs in layer 11

query_dependence.intervention: target CLS Q slice <- paired-control CLS Q slice; K and V remain native
query_dependence.null_family: all 45 candidate-excluding two-head pairs in layer 11
query_dependence.endpoint: native target margin minus query-patched target margin

path_rescue.corruption: source-head target CLS contexts <- paired-control contexts
path_rescue.rescue: while source heads remain corrupted, restore a layer-11 pair from the cached native target run
path_rescue.null_family: all 45 candidate-excluding two-head pairs in layer 11

confirmation_opens_only_if: clean enrichment is at least 0.50 logits with positive 95% bootstrap lower bound
at least one of pair specificity, query dependence, or path rescue qualifies

mechanistic_boundary: Strict complement scrub tests whether retained CLS writes are self-contained relative to the declared 156-node universe; it does not include token-position writes outside CLS.
Pair specificity compares equal-size interventions within layer 11 and does not establish a directed path.
Query transfer can implicate target-dependent Q gating but does not separate QK addressing from downstream V content.
Rescue is directed mediation evidence only if the upstream corruption has a qualified effect and the frozen mediator pair rescues more than every equal-size layer-11 null pair.
Source-band and motif surgery remain sealed until a directed path is supported.
